visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot focuses on a white tablet screen displaying the 'Animation Desk' interface. At the top, the app title is clearly visible. A hand with short fingernails and a pale complexion enters from the bottom right, its index finger pressing down on a thumbnail labeled '001'. On the main canvas, a simple black line-drawing of a round-bodied character with large eyes waves its right hand. The lighting is bright and even, reflecting off the screen surface. (2) The hand shifts slightly and taps the thumbnail labeled '003'. The central character instantly changes pose to a crouching position with its arms tucked in, maintaining its round silhouette and wide-eyed expression. The background of the tablet interface remains a clean, static white workspace. The surrounding environment outside the screen is dimly lit and out of focus. (3) The hand moves further to the right to tap thumbnail '005'. The animated character now stands upright with both arms spread wide in a joyful, welcoming gesture. The finger then rapidly cycles back and forth between thumbnails '003', '004', and '005', creating a rhythmic, frame-by-frame animation effect where the character appears to bounce and dance in sync with the physical tapping. (4) The sequence concludes with the hand hovering over the '004' thumbnail as the character stands with its arms at its sides. The camera remains static throughout the recording, maintaining a consistent eye-level perspective on the interaction between the human hand and the digital interface.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A solo male voice initiates the audio track by singing the phrase 'Gwaenchana' with a melodic, slightly teasing inflection. The background music features a bright, up-tempo electronic beat with a prominent 4/4 kick drum and a repetitive synth melody. The spectral brightness is high, giving the track a crisp, digital feel. (2) As the music continues, the vocalist performs a rhythmic series of 'ding-ding-ding' syllables that perfectly align with the electronic tempo. Very faint, high-frequency incidental clicking sounds occur periodically, consistent with a finger tapping a glass screen. The audio environment is extremely clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio and no noticeable ambient floor. (3) The vocal loop repeats the 'Gwaenchana' lyric, maintaining a consistent volume and playful energy. The harmonic structure is simple and stable, creating a lighthearted and comedic atmosphere. The track concludes with the electronic beat still driving forward, ending in a clean hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a creative demonstration of the 'Animation Desk' app, using a popular rhythmic meme audio to bring a simple line-drawing to life through manual frame switching. The core appeal lies in the satisfying synchronization between the user's physical taps and the character's animated movements.
